summary: Inventory sources load in the order given, adding all and ungrouped at the end. Order matters for parent/child definitions since YAML and INI plugins drop empty groups after each source, and the last variable definition wins.
questions: Why do I get a parsing error about a missing child group across inventory files?
Which inventory source wins if a variable is defined twice?

answer_card.title: Inventory load order
answer_card.answer_md:
Sources load in the order you give them, and hosts, groups and variables are defined as encountered (`all`/`ungrouped` added at the end).
- Reorder sources if parent/child groups must exist before they're referenced. YAML and INI plugins discard empty groups at the end of each source, which can cause parse errors.
- For variables, the **last definition wins**.
